description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Time-Integrated Coastal Flood Risk Assessment to Enhance Civil Infrastructure Resilience is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jun-Whan Lee, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). As climate change exacerbates coastal flooding threats, critical infrastructure like transportation and energy systems faces increasing disruptions. Rapid intensification of hurricanes, flash floods, and high tide flooding occur more frequently, leaving coastal communities, especially underserved populations, little time to prepare for evacuation. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-p9ty-6z17. Keywords: Coastal flooding, storm surge, risk assessment, climate change, resilience. Published 2024-06-16. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
